checks.name: continuous activity renews without an idle gap
activity types share one cadence and capture registration
each activity type can independently renew
current session, logout, missing token, and near-expiry guards
unmount removes listeners and session timers
idle expiry retains refresh request and prompt
actual relogin returns pending promise and preserves successful result
actual relogin propagates rejection and aborts the older request
Timeout stays open while pending and closes after success
Timeout rejection remains retryable and successful retry clears expiry timer
Timeout failure retains refresh expiry logout

mocks: React hooks use a deterministic state, ref, effect, and callback model.
Document listeners use a controlled event registry and capture option checks.
Date and browser timers use a controlled clock.
Axios post returns controlled promises and records request arguments.
JWT decoding, analytics, dispatcher side effects, and logout are controlled inputs.
waitFor resolves immediately in Timeout characterization.
limits: Actual changed TypeScript executes after Node stripTypeScriptTypes transformation.
